title: Cyberpunk FPS Game Trailer
summary: Trailer beat sheet for a cyberpunk FPS vertical slice with traversal, combat clarity, and faction reveal.
prompt: Create a 10-second trailer plan for {argument name="game_title" default="Neon Breach"}, a cyberpunk FPS. Beat 0-1s: rain-lit alley title pulse. Beat 1-2.5s: first-person slide under drone scan. Beat 2.5-4s: weapon swap and shield break. Beat 4-6s: faction boss reveal through holographic smoke. Beat 6-8s: wall-run, grenade arc, slow impact frame. Beat 8-10s: key art end frame with platform badges. Keep HUD overlays readable and grounded in gameplay.
